```{r SetUp, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  comment = "#>", echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE
)

library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(gridExtra)
library(patchwork)

# Load configuration and functions
source(here::here("config.R"))
```


```{r datapre}
# Load rasters
flc_5km_r <- rast(flc_5km_mosacic_file)[[1]]
ai_5km_r <- rast(ai_5km_file) * 0.0001
cor_twi_vegh_r <- rast(cor_twi_vegh_mosaic_file)[[1]]

# Align extent of FLC with AI
flc_5km_r <- crop(flc_5km_r, ai_5km_r)

# Stack and convert to data frame
df <- as.data.frame(c(cor_twi_vegh_r, flc_5km_r, ai_5km_r), xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(df) <- c("lon", "lat", "cor", "fused", "ai")
```

```{r dfbin}

# Create 0.1 interval bins for 'fused'
df_binned <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(fused)) %>%
  mutate(fused_bin = cut(
    fused,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = FALSE,
    labels = paste0(
      sprintf("%.1f", seq(0.0, 0.9, by = 0.1)),
      "–",
      sprintf("%.1f", seq(0.1, 1.0, by = 0.1))
    )
  ))

bins <- unique(df_binned$fused_bin)
```


```{r binsplot1,fig.width=15,fig.height=15}
plot_list <- lapply(bins, function(bin_label) {
  df_sub <- df_binned %>% filter(fused_bin == bin_label)

  # lm model for slope
  lm_fit <- lm(cor ~ ai, data = df_sub)
  slope <- round(coef(lm_fit)[2], 3) 
  intercept <- round(coef(lm_fit)[1], 3)

  ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = ai, y = cor)) +
    geom_hex(bins = 40) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", trans = "sqrt") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
    xlim(0, 7) +
    ylim(-1, 1) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 6.5, y = 0.9,
      label = paste0("Slope: ", slope),
      size = 4, hjust = 1, color = "red"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Fused:", bin_label),
      x = "Aridity Index",
      y = "Correlation",
      fill = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
})

grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 3)

```

```{r binsplot2,fig.width=15,fig.height=15}
plot_list2 <- lapply(bins, function(bin_label) {
  df_sub <- df_binned %>% filter(fused_bin == bin_label)

  # lm model for slope
  lm_fit <- lm(cor ~ ai, data = df_sub)
  slope <- round(coef(lm_fit)[2], 3)  # 提取斜率并四舍五入
  intercept <- round(coef(lm_fit)[1], 3)

  ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = ai, y = cor)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 40) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", trans = "sqrt") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.5), ylim = c(-1, 1)) +  # ← 放大 ai 区间
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.45, y = 0.9,
    label = paste0("Slope: ", slope),
    size = 4, hjust = 1, color = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Fused:", bin_label),
    x = "Aridity Index",
    y = "Correlation",
    fill = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
})

grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list2, ncol = 4)

```
